'''Tantas''' were quadrupedal [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] native to [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], akin to [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]]. They were the primary domestic animals of [[Talid/Legends|Talids]].
